scope: One authored scalar posthoc resource-accounting check of four AST-extracted functions; no project imports, full analysis, persistence, geometry, study replay or scientific execution.
runtime_identity_scope: Captured interpreter/version/platform strings and installed distribution version metadata only; no executable or package-content identity, and no agreement with the lockfile was enforced.
counts_and_timing_scope: Execution bookkeeping; no measured research cost, impact or performance evidence.
source_identity_scope: Six authored source/test/configuration/dependency-declaration files; not a project import closure or installed package-content inventory.

execution_seam.method: AST-extract and execute four function definitions using stdlib-only bindings; no project module imports or analyze_study statements.

resource_contract.unknown: None is unknown; zero is observed; known costs on evaluation_missing assignments are retained.
resource_contract.accepted_values: Exactly native nonnegative int or finite float values, excluding bool and subclasses; storage bytes require int.
resource_contract.accounting_sum_policy: Integer-only sums remain exact; any float uses math.fsum with binary64 precision and conversion/overflow limits.
resource_contract.stage_statistics_scope: Already validated observations converted to finite binary64; approximate mean/extrema and linearly interpolated quantiles at ranks (n - 1) * p. Empty statistics are null.
resource_contract.stage_accounting_scope: sum_observed and missing_assigned copy the corresponding coverage observed_sum and missing; exact integer byte sums are separate from approximate statistics.
resource_contract.posthoc_binary64_boundary: The complete posthoc helper rejects nonfinite conversion/statistics even when a huge integer is valid in exact coverage alone.

paired_top_level_seconds.kind: six-field coverage summary; not a distribution
paired_top_level_seconds.rule: Sum the two enclosing clocks within each assignment only when both are known, then summarize those per-assignment pairs.
paired_top_level_seconds.alias: observed_incremental_top_level_seconds reads paired_top_level_seconds.observed_sum, null when no complete pair is observed.
paired_top_level_seconds.rounding: Rowwise binary64 pair sums can round differently from separately summed marginal fields.
paired_top_level_seconds.scope: Two recorded enclosing incremental timers only; no nested timers, shared costs or lifecycle completeness.

resource_contract.schema_and_wiring_scope: Fresh producer source contract only; full analyze_study construction, schema/provenance wiring and persistence were not executed by this check.
resource_contract.geometry_measured_distribution_policy: Existing geometry measured_distribution source unchanged; geometry pipeline not executed.
resource_contract.historical_posthoc_analysis_policy: Existing /1 records remain unchanged; no historical re-analysis.

captured_regression_coverage: Fixed eight-field coverage/stage shape, counts, nullable totals, retained known costs on evaluation_missing assignments and immutable inputs.
Complete, incomplete, complementary partial and mixed pairs; unknown, known-zero, all-unknown, empty and top-only/nested-only cases.
Exact large integer byte sums separate from approximate statistics; finite binary64 statistics, quantile interpolation, overflow and subnormal examples.
math.fsum accounting and rowwise pair rounding; per-pair and aggregate overflow rejection.
Native numeric and cost-container type boundaries, integer-only storage, malformed cost rejection and ignored extra keys.
limitations: Availability covers supplied assignments and recorded values only; it does not establish complete instrumentation or lifecycle coverage.
If fit_options raises before returning, local options remains empty and fit_seconds_all_options can report zero despite attempted fitting; producer repair remains deferred to a separate PR.
Option timers are nested in fit/selection/materialization; native, binary64, verification and export timers are nested in heldout workflow and are not additive to enclosing timers.
Current timer samples exclude some later persistence, scans and hashing; storage is an immediate-file scan before the current outcome write.
Stage statistics are approximate binary64 and can reject huge integer observations accepted by exact coverage; finite rowwise pairs can round differently from marginal totals.
Paired completeness concerns only the two recorded enclosing clocks within supplied assignments, not all eight fields, shared preparation or full lifecycle cost.
No producer execution, full summarize_main, full analyze_study, schema/provenance wiring, geometry, JSON persistence, lineage loading, study replay or scientific artifact execution.
Historical /1 analyses, failed work, scientific outcomes and earlier receipt scopes are not recovered, rewritten or broadened.
Cold acquisition/preparation/encoding, memory/energy, model/device coverage and full inference maintenance remain incomplete.
Runtime continuity concerns captured strings and installed version metadata, not interpreter executable or package-content identity or lockfile agreement.
No measured research cost, full lifecycle total, amortization crossover, cost advantage, causal usefulness or business-impact claim.
Documentation snippets remain unexecuted; recorded test does not verify later documentation/publication edits or hosted CI.
